tests.name: createState defaults: two finite teams at the harbour, all resources finite, allClear
knots conversion is exact: 12 kn team covers the distance in distance/(12*1.852) hours
undersized first team fails alone; reinforcement with bigger pump resolves (sensor-confirmed)
travel completes only after the full distance; no early arrival, no overshoot, no work before arrival
resources unavailable until return; released and reusable after arrival at harbour
received GPS staleness derives from fix sample time; old backlog after outage does not look fresh
lost command never executes; retransmit works; an outage delays (does not lose) commands
pump fault: command fails, sensors disagree, resolution only after a healthy pump
input validation: IDs, finite numbers, safe-integer personnel, coordinates, time — atomic rejection
impossible transitions rejected: return off-scene, work on resolved incident, reinforce without mission, drop executed command
pump commands are incident-scoped: STOP_PUMP for incident B cannot stop incident A pump
resolved incident is not frozen: continuing ingress reopens it after the pump stops
deterministic: identical inputs produce identical state trajectories
fuel is consumed on the move; a low-fuel team strands and the incident stays unresolved
partial personnel allocation limits the rescue rate and leaves crew ashore
large-tick equivalence: a 300s tick equals sixty 5s ticks (no event skipped)
final-return fuel exhaustion: a team stranding on the return leg does not release resources
